name: Third Street Dive
description: Third Street Dive is a lively Louisville venue known for its authentic dive bar atmosphere combined with a vibrant karaoke scene. Open late until 4 AM, it offers a wide variety of drinks and a welcoming crowd that enjoys singing, socializing, and live music. The venue's friendly staff and casual vibe make it a favorite for both locals and visitors seeking an unpretentious, fun-filled night of karaoke and entertainment.
